description: This file defines the CUDAGraph class and related utilities for CUDA graph capture and replay in PyTorch's ATen library, including methods for managing CUDA graphs, generator states, and device contexts.

classes.name: CUDAGraph
classes.description: Represents a CUDA graph for capturing and replaying CUDA operations, with methods for managing graph lifecycle, generator states, and debugging.

methods.name: CUDAGraph
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a CUDA graph, with an option to keep the graph after capture.

methods.name: ~CUDAGraph
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up CUDA graph resources.

methods.name: register_generator_state
methods.description: Registers a generator state with the CUDA graph.

methods.name: capture_begin
methods.description: Starts capturing CUDA operations into the graph with specified mempool and capture mode.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Instantiates the captured CUDA graph for execution.

methods.name: pool
methods.description: Returns the mempool ID associated with the CUDA graph.

methods.name: enable_debug_mode
methods.description: Enables debug mode for the CUDA graph.

methods.name: debug_dump
methods.description: Dumps debug information to the specified path.

methods.name: raw_cuda_graph
methods.description: Returns the raw CUDA graph handle.

methods.name: raw_cuda_graph_exec
methods.description: Returns the executable CUDA graph handle.
